Full documentation, tutorials, function reference live pkgdown site.

what: Save a spinviz diagram to file — save_diagram
title: Save a spinviz diagram to file — save_diagram
text: Saves either kind plot package produces: heatmap heatmap_diagram sunburst sunburst_diagram_echarts, detecting one plot class applying matching export logic width:height ratio. Supply width height either diagram type, whichever supply derived relevant fixed ratio diagram keeps proportions. supply match ratio: heatmaps, see enforce_ratio; sunbursts, used exactly given (enforcement). Export format set extension file. Heatmaps go ggsave, accepts format supports (.png, .pdf, .svg, .jpg/.jpeg, .tiff/.tif, .bmp, ...). Sunbursts restricted .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.pdf, via chromote directly (Chrome's Page.captureScreenshot raster, Page.printToPDF PDF. type's ratio derived (kept separate, since two diagrams built way): Heatmap: body diagram panel always drawn fixed height:width 1.1:1 (theme(aspect.ratio = 1.1) inside heatmap_diagram). varies extra width outside panel: labels/values reserve data-width 1.35 vs. 1.00 neither shown (exact, coord_cartesian(xlim = ...)), legend adds estimated ~15% extra width shown (measured real render, placeholder worth checking actual output), view_choice = "" uses combined front+gap+back width (1 : 0.10 : 1, exact, plot_layout(widths = ...)). Sunburst: fixed ratio computed . sunburst_diagram_echarts records exact widget_width/widget_height built , recorded ratio scaled directly.
code: p1 <- heatmap_diagram(df, "boxing", "front", sex = "male") save_diagram(p1, file = "heatmap.png", width = 1600, units = "px")  p2 <- sunburst_diagram_echarts(df, "boxing") save_diagram(p2, file = "sunburst.jpg", width = 1500)

title: Save a spinviz diagram to file — save_diagram
text: plot plot/widget object returned heatmap_diagram sunburst_diagram_echarts. file Output file path. See Description extensions valid diagram type. width, height Size saved file. Supply least one, derived relevant ratio. default NULL. view_choice Heatmap . One "front", "back", "". Left NULL (default) auto-detect plot's recorded metadata. show_labels, show_values, show_scale Heatmap . Logical, NULL (default) auto-detect plot's recorded metadata. units Heatmap . Units width/height: "px" (default), "", "cm", "mm". dpi Heatmap . Resolution dots per inch, raster formats (effect .pdf/.svg/.eps). Default 300. enforce_ratio Heatmap . Logical. TRUE (default) supply width height mismatched ratio, height recalculated match warning explains . Set FALSE deliberately stretch diagram. bg Heatmap . Background colour. Default "white". heatmap_diagram uses theme_void(), background fill , many image viewers render transparency solid grey rather white. Set NA genuinely transparent export. delay Sunburst . Seconds wait page loads capturing, giving ECharts time finish drawing (especially label layout pass). Default 1. ... Heatmap . arguments passed ggsave.

title: Save a spinviz diagram to file — save_diagram
code: subcategory <- c("Head","Neck","Shoulder","Chest","Upper Arm","Elbow",                   "Abdomen","Forearm","Hip Groin","Wrist","Hand",                   "Thigh","Knee","Lower Leg","Ankle","Foot","Thoracic Spine","Lumbosacral") region_area <- rep("Example", length(subcategory)) boxing <- c(15, 5, 18, 12, 20, 6, 10, 14, 9, 9, 11, 3, 16, 13, 7, 8, 18, 22) df_heatmap <- data.frame(region_area, subcategory, boxing)  tissue <- c('Muscle/tendon','Muscle/tendon','Nervous','Bone','Bone',             'Cartilage/Synovium/Bursa','Ligament/Joint capsule',             'Superficial tissues/skin','Vessels','Internal organs') pathology <- c('Muscle injury','Tendon rupture','Peripheral nerve injury',                'Fracture','Bone contusion','Cartilage injury','Joint sprain',                'Laceration','Vascular trauma','Organ trauma') injuries <- c(20, 10, 16, 16, 10, 67, 27, 82, 26, 34) df_sunburst <- data.frame(tissue, pathology, injuries)  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Heatmap: type detected automatically, ratio comes from heatmap_diagram()'s # own recorded metadata (view_choice, show_labels, show_values, show_scale) p1 <- heatmap_diagram(df_heatmap, "boxing", "front", sex = "male") save_diagram(p1, file = "heatmap.png", width = 1600, units = "px")  # "both" view, exported as PDF p2 <- heatmap_diagram(df_heatmap, "boxing", "both", sex = "male") save_diagram(p2, file = "heatmap_both.pdf", width = 2400, units = "px")  # Sunburst: ratio comes from sunburst_diagram_echarts()'s own recorded # widget_width/widget_height instead; no units argument needed (always px) p3 <- sunburst_diagram_echarts(df_sunburst, "injuries") save_diagram(p3, file = "sunburst.jpg", width = 1500)  # Sunburst as PDF: same call shape again, just a different extension save_diagram(p3, file = "sunburst.pdf", width = 1500)  # Overriding recorded metadata explicitly (e.g. plot came from an older # version of heatmap_diagram() with no attached metadata) save_diagram(p1, file = "heatmap_custom.png",              view_choice = "front", show_labels = TRUE,              show_values = FALSE, show_scale = TRUE,              width = 1200, units = "px") } # }

title: Sunburst diagram — sunburst_diagram_echarts
text: data (Required) data frame Tissue type, Pathology type, sporting injury counts. Expected follow Olympic Committee standards reporting epidemiological data injury illness sport. Expects least 3 columns; must following order, column name important: 1: Tissue, string format, e.g. "Muscle/tendon" 2: Pathology type, string format, e.g. "Muscle Injury" 3...n: Injury frequency, positive integer. Rather typing Tissue/Pathology columns , can start built-injury_categories taxonomy (already columns 1 2 filled standard classification) just add injury counts column 3. See sunburst_diagram_default(). data lives CSV file, create_sunburst_template() writes template pre-filled injury_categories taxonomy, read_sunburst_data() reads completed file back , validating column structure category labels. column_name string name column contains injury frequency. use 3rd column unspecified. replace_names vector strings contains original replacement values tissue/pathology names, e.g. c("Muscle/tendon"="Muscle"). Applied data tree built. depth integer: 1 shows tissue-level rings , anything else (default -1) shows tissue pathology rings. palette string vector hex colours - BASE (tissue-level) colour palette. Can value hcl.pals()/viridis, vector hex values, one per tissue type (excluding "Unspecified", always grey). Pathology (outer ring) colours automatically derived lightened versions parent tissue's colour. transparency number 0 1 diagram opacity. Default 1. plot_title string title diagram. font_size, font_style, font_color, font_family Text styling slice labels (font_style accepts "italic"/"normal", mapped CSS fontStyle). title_size, title_color, title_x, title_y, title_family Text/position styling plot title. title_x/title_y accept ECharts position keywords ("left"/"center"/"right", "top"/"middle"/"bottom") px/%. include_non_specific Logical toggle. FALSE, rows Tissue "Unspecified" excluded diagram entirely. TRUE (default), included always coloured grey, regardless palette. inner_radius, mid_radius, outer_radius Strings (ECharts radius units, e.g. "15%") controlling, respectively: size blank centre hole, outer edge tissue ring/inner edge pathology ring, outer edge pathology ring. Defaults: "10%", "40%", "50%". label_line_length, label_line_length2 Numbers (pixels) controlling two segments leader line connecting outer-ring label back slice: label_line_length segment hugging slice edge, label_line_length2 segment running label text. Increase (/shrink outer_radius) pull labels reduce crowding. Defaults: 40, 80. min_label_angle Minimum slice angle (degrees) slice's label hidden reduce clutter. Default 2. outer_label_width Maximum width (pixels) outer-ring label wraps. Default 90. show_outer_labels Logical. FALSE, hides outer-ring (pathology) labels leader lines entirely. slices still render still hoverable via tooltip. TRUE (default), labels show usual. widget_width, widget_height Size htmlwidget canvas, e.g. "1200px". Also recorded returned widget used save_diagram() derive export ratio. Defaults "1200px" "1500px".

code: # Easiest: start from the built-in injury_categories taxonomy # (Tissue/Pathology columns are already filled in) and add your # own injury counts. See ?injury_categories for the category order. df <- injury_categories  df$boxing <- c(   10, 19, 19, 41, 31, 18, 16, 16, 10, 10,   27, 46, 67, 31, 54, 10, 27, 10, 96, 82,   48, 26, 33, 34, 24 )  df$judo <- c(   25, 45, 37, 31, 19, 41, 48, 14, 49, 26,   42, 24, 14, 16, 37, 41, 23, 36, 33, 44,   48, 41, 31, 25, 48 )  p1 <- sunburst_diagram_echarts(df, "boxing") p2 <- sunburst_diagram_echarts(df, "judo")  # Alternatively, supply the complete Tissue and Pathology names # directly. Categories that are not required can be omitted. # This example excludes the unspecified injury category. Tissue <- c(   "Muscle/Tendon", "Muscle/Tendon", "Muscle/Tendon",   "Muscle/Tendon", "Muscle/Tendon",   "Nervous", "Nervous",   "Bone", "Bone", "Bone", "Bone", "Bone",   "Cartilage/Synovium/Bursa", "Cartilage/Synovium/Bursa",   "Cartilage/Synovium/Bursa", "Cartilage/Synovium/Bursa",   "Ligament/Joint capsule", "Ligament/Joint capsule",   "Superficial tissues/skin", "Superficial tissues/skin",   "Superficial tissues/skin",   "Vessels",   "Stump",   "Internal organs" )  Pathology <- c(   "Muscle injury",   "Muscle contusion",   "Muscle compartment syndrome",   "Tendinopathy",   "Tendon rupture",   "Brain/Spinal cord injury",   "Peripheral nerve Injury",   "Fracture",   "Bone stress injury",   "Bone contusion",   "Avascular necrosis",   "Physis injury",   "Cartilage injury",   "Arthritis",   "Synovitis/Capsulitis",   "Bursitis",   "Joint sprain (ligament tear or acute instability episode)",   "Chronic instability",   "Contusion (superficial)",   "Laceration",   "Abrasion",   "Vascular trauma",   "Stump injury",   "Organ trauma" )  boxing2 <- c(   10, 19, 19, 41, 31, 18, 16, 16, 10, 10,   27, 46, 67, 31, 54, 10, 27, 10, 96, 82,   48, 26, 33, 34 )  df2 <- data.frame(   Tissue,   Pathology,   boxing = boxing2 )  p3 <- sunburst_diagram_echarts(df2, "boxing")

text: New sunburst_diagram_echarts() renders interactive tissue/pathology sunburst diagram using echarts4r. New built-taxonomies: body_categories (19-row region_area/subcategory, used heatmap) injury_categories (25-row tissue/pathology, used sunburst), counts attached, ready combine counts. New create_sunburst_template() writes template CSV pre-filled 25-row injury_categories tissue/pathology taxonomy one empty column per requested sport, ready filled injury frequencies. New read_sunburst_data() reads validates CSV, checking required tissue/pathology columns least one sport column, warning unrecognised (possibly misspelled) tissue/pathology values, carrying blank tissue cells row compact hand-edited files work.

title: spinviz 0.0.1.0000
text: Extended test suite cover sunburst_diagram_echarts(), sunburst_diagram_default(), save_diagram() (92 tests total). chromote-based sunburst export test skips gracefully Chromium-based browser available (e.g. CRAN minimal CI images). Added echarts4r, htmlwidgets, tools Imports, chromote base64enc Suggests (needed sunburst export save_diagram()). save_diagram() now validates sunburst widget’s recorded size metadata checking chromote/base64enc installed, informative error always one reported. sunburst_diagram_echarts(), tcltk pop-error_messages() helper replaced standard stop()/warning(), warnings argument removed. Updated README document sunburst diagrams, built-taxonomies, convenience wrappers, save_diagram(), refreshed example figures (heatmaps regenerated new code; new sunburst figure exported via chromote). New create_injury_template() writes template CSV pre-filled recognised body subcategories one column per requested sport, ready filled injury frequencies. New read_injury_data() reads validates CSV, checking required region_area/subcategory columns, least one sport column, unrecognised (possibly misspelled) subcategory values. Files read check.names = FALSE user-supplied column names preserved exactly written. Added rsvg Imports. required runtime magick::image_read_svg() rendering SVG body diagrams, absence caused failures systems (e.g. CI runners) already installed. Removed duplicate grDevices entry DESCRIPTION Imports. Added tests/testthat suite covering diagram_colours(), test_colour(), heatmap_diagram(). heatmap_diagram() longer calls print() result returning , previously caused plot render twice R Markdown/Quarto documents call left unassigned. heatmap_diagram() now warns values selected sport column converted numeric, instead silently coercing NA. heatmap_diagram()’s documentation palette argument now regenerated longer shows stale “WIP” placeholder text. heatmap_diagram()’s front/back label coordinate tables now built single shared lookup (label_position_lookup()) instead two hand-duplicated tables, views silently drift apart. heatmap_diagram()’s combined “views” label table (both_label_position_lookup()) now validates front-/back-regions single source truth (view_exclusive_regions()) used SVG id per-view label lookups, instead re-encoding regions one-sided third time. test_colour() now restores caller’s graphics::par() settings exit instead permanently changing plotting layout (mfrow). Fixed documentation typo test_colour() (“coloublind” -> “colourblind”). Documentation moved pkgdown site (https://bnqcasimiro.github.io/spinviz/): “Get started” vignette runnable examples, articles importing CSV data customising saving diagrams, grouped function reference. README correspondingly slimmer, keeping installation quick examples.
